headline: Balmer Lawrie files writ petition in Karnataka High Court against GST penalty
hook: Legal challenge against a GST penalty order
summary: Balmer Lawrie & Co has filed a writ petition before the High Court of Karnataka challenging an appellate order dated August 17, 2026. The order pertains to a GST penalty under the CGST/KGST Act for the financial year 2020-21. The company submitted the petition through the Quick E-Filing System on October 5, 2026, following disclosure requirements under SEBI regulations.
why_it_matters: Tax litigation outcome may impact company financials upon resolution.
